claim_boundary.allowed_if_gate_passes: promising preliminary evidence from a bounded non-causal pilot

population.eligibility: students in grades 9-12 attending the September 2026 FinanceMeta financial-literacy module
population.recruitment: opt-in through the host school/program; no payment, grade credit, or financial incentive for participating in evaluation
population.consent: follow host-school and applicable guardian/participant consent requirements before collecting evaluation data
population.privacy: use pseudonymous participant IDs only; do not collect household income, account balances, bank details, investment holdings, or other unnecessary personal financial data

assessment.note: These are original concept-aligned pilot items, not canonical GFLEC item wording and not a claim of instrument equivalence.

pre_form.prompt: You place 100 monetary units in an account earning 10% interest per year, with interest added annually. If you make no deposits or withdrawals, how much is in the account after two years?
Your savings earn 3% in one year while prices rise 5% over the same year. Compared with today, what can the savings buy after one year?
choices: Cannot tell from the information given

pre_form.prompt: Which choice usually reduces exposure to the failure of any single company?
choices: Keeping all money in one sector
Borrowing to buy more of one stock

pre_form.prompt: Two loans have the same amount and term. Loan X has a lower annual percentage rate than Loan Y and no extra fees. Which loan should have the lower financing cost?
Which statement best reflects the relationship between investment risk and expected return?
choices: Higher expected return is generally available with no added risk
Higher expected return generally comes with accepting more uncertainty or risk
Risk disappears if an asset did well last year
A diversified investment can never lose value

post_form.prompt: You place 200 monetary units in an account earning 5% interest per year, with interest added annually. If you make no deposits or withdrawals, how much is in the account after two years?
Your pay rises 2% while the prices of the things you buy rise 6%. If nothing else changes, your purchasing power has most likely done what?
Which portfolio is least dependent on the performance of one business?
choices: Five shares of the same company
A broad fund holding many companies and sectors
Two companies in the same industry

post_form.prompt: For otherwise identical loans with no extra fees, what happens to total financing cost when the interest rate is higher?
An investment advertises much higher expected returns than a government-backed savings product. Which response is most financially literate?
choices: Expect that the higher return may involve higher risk and investigate that risk
Borrow as much as possible to invest
Treat the advertised return as guaranteed

scenario_transfer.prompt: A student has a fixed monthly allowance. Food and transport prices rise, but the allowance does not. Which action best preserves the budget without taking on debt?
choices: Recalculate spending categories and reduce lower-priority spending
Assume inflation will automatically increase the allowance
Use a high-interest loan for routine spending

scenario_transfer.prompt: A student wants long-term market exposure but is worried that one company could fail. Which principle most directly addresses that concern?

scoring.knowledge_score: 1 point per correct item; 0 otherwise; report 0-5 and percentage
scoring.scenario_transfer_score: 1 point per correct transfer item; 0 otherwise; report 0-2 and percentage
scoring.confidence_calibration: report mean confidence for correct and incorrect responses separately; do not combine into the primary outcome

analysis.primary_metric: paired post knowledge percentage minus paired pre knowledge percentage among participants with both forms

missing_data.primary: complete-pair analysis only; never impute a missing post-test as improvement
missing_data.reporting: report enrolled, pre-complete, post-complete, paired-complete, and dropout counts separately
missing_data.sensitivity: report baseline pre-score for completers versus non-completers when at least five non-completers exist

analysis.exclusions: exclude only duplicate technical records, participants outside frozen eligibility, or records lacking consent; report counts and reasons

promising_preliminary_evidence_requires_: post-test missingness among pre-test completers is at most 25%
mean paired knowledge change is at least +10 percentage points
median paired knowledge change is at least +1 of 5 items
post scenario-transfer accuracy is at least 60%
no material integrity or consent failure is discovered
inconclusive_if: cohort or completion thresholds are not met
knowledge and transfer indicators materially disagree
redesign_required_if: mean paired knowledge change is negative
median paired knowledge change is zero or negative while the mean is below +10 percentage points
an integrity, consent, or privacy breach invalidates the pilot

required: paired effect size with uncertainty when sample size permits
reporting.prohibited: Do not publish participant-level identities or raw free-text responses. Do not describe outputs such as attendance as learning outcomes.
